text:
mira-rep: Hey team — Aurora Health wants a hosted demo key for a client-facing POC next Thursday. Needs chat+embeddings, IP allowlist (3 IPs), short TTL, billing tag 'poc/aurora-demo', and a concise rotate/revoke playbook for their security reviewer.

eli-eng: We can issue ephemeral hosted keys scoped to chat+embeds. Security usually recommends 24h TTL for hosted creds; 48h only if security signs off. We can pre-create a standby key and drop both into 1Password. Send IPs + demo contact.

mira-rep: IPs: 198.51.100.200, 198.51.100.201, 198.51.100.202. Contact: demo@aurora.example.com. They prefer 36h but will accept 24h if needed.

sophia-sec: Note for questionnaire: Console -> Activity -> API Keys export includes create/rotate/revoke events, creator identity, allowlist, and metadata. Hosted keys are managed by Redwood control plane; per-customer KMS wrapping is only available on Private/Dedicated. Flag as blocker if they insist on KMS/HSM.

eli-eng: API snippet I'll use (admin token redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"poc-aurora-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":10,"allowlist_ips":["198.51.100.200","198.51.100.201","198.51.100.202"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/aurora-demo","contact":"demo@aurora.example.com"}}'

ops-bot: key created: hosted_key_poc_aurora_2145678901 — created_by: eli-eng — expires_in: 24h — scopes: chat, embeddings — rate_limit:10 req/s

mira-rep: Perfect. Can you also provide the short playbook we can drop into the buyer packet? Security wants explicit revocation steps if the laptop is lost mid-demo.

sophia-sec: Playbook bullets: 1) Issue ephemeral key (24h) scoped to chat+embeds and restrict to the 3 IPs. 2) Store primary + standby in 1Password. 3) If compromise suspected call revoke endpoint immediately (see curl). 4) If you need KMS/HSM escalate to Solutions Eng for a Private trial. 5) Export Console Activity CSV and attach to the RFP.

eli-eng: Revoke example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_key_poc_aurora_2145678901/revoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

eli-eng: Also add this mitigation: pre-create standby key and a short retrieval pattern so we can swap keys quickly during a demo without exposing long-lived plaintext in emails.

sophia-sec: One more: document that plaintext for hosted keys is accessible in control plane briefly; for strict auditors propose Private/Dedicated with customer KMS. We'll include that language in the questionnaire response.

ops-bot: key revoked: hosted_key_poc_aurora_2145678901 — revoked_by: eli-eng — revocation_time: 2145679205

mira-rep: Thanks everyone — I uploaded the playbook, activity export, and the revoke screenshot to the deal folder and shared with the customer security reviewer. They accepted 24h and IP allowlist. Closing the prep loop. :white_check_mark:
